name: Summer Senses Luxury Resort
positioning: Cycladic-style resort on the eastern edge of Paros, a two-minute walk from Punda Beach, with private-pool suites and Aegean Sea views
best_for: Couples wanting a suite with a private pool and Aegean views
Beach lovers and kitesurfers on the quieter east coast of Paros

facts.text: The resort is on the eastern edge of Paros and has Aegean Sea views.
The resort is near the seaside village of Piso Livadi, and the village of Marpissa is a stone's throw away.
The resort is about 19 km from Paroikia Port and 12 km from Naoussa town.
Punda Beach, a two-minute walk away, is known for crystal clear, deep blue waters and has two beach bars.
The hotel has two swimming pools.
Spa therapies are offered at the Anassa Spa by Idolo.
Deluxe Rooms have an elegantly minimal Cycladic style and open to a private outdoor space.
Premium Suites feature Parian marble flooring.
Sea-view Sun Suites and Island Suites have views of the Aegean and sunrise vistas.
Gaia Restaurant serves an authentic Greek breakfast.
A 3 km seaside path connects Punda Beach with Piso Livadi and Logaras.

highlights.text: Several suite types have an outdoor private pool, including Summer Suites and Senses Suites with views of the Aegean over the coastline.
The Honeymoon Suite has a private pool, a sea view and an outdoor heated jacuzzi.
Punda Beach is a two-minute walk from the resort.
Guests can spend an afternoon kitesurfing on Punda Beach.

considerations.text: The resort is on the east coast, about 19 km from Paroikia Port and 12 km from Naoussa town.
WhataHotel notes the location requires transportation to Paros town center.
